addendum_content_raw:
(1) In my initial 2014 Financial Disclosure Report | noted in Section VII that items 63-68 of Part VII were incorrectly included im my 2013 Financial Disclosure

Report, as | could find no evidence | sold them during 2014, and yet no evidence I owned them at the end of 2014. For that reason 1 did not include them in my

initial 2014 Report, but | stated 1 would continue to look for records to explain this anamoly.

urchased

2003. So the funds

1 have since located the appropriate records. These funds are in a non-qualified annunity

themselves were properly reported in the 2013 Report, and this amendment to the 2014 Report added them at limes 123-32 in Section VIL

| have also since learned that annuities such as these have no dividend or interest incomes, but rather the funds simply change in value over time. Income is

reported (through an IRS Form 1099) upon a withdrawal of which there have been none, So 1 have reported no income on these items on this amended 2014

Report. My reported income on the 2013 Report was based on estimates of the values of the funds, but was incorrect. 1 will amend my 2013 Report if required.

(2) Part VIL, item 22 on my 2013 Financial Disclosure Report was also incorrectly reported. The mvestment was titled "ISHARES Russell 1000 Value Index

Fund." 1 have since learned that it is the same fund as "ISHARES Russell 1000 Value Fund.” It was incorrectly separated from several disclosures of the

"ISHARES Russell 1000 Fund™ made on the 2013 Form (items 7, 33, 44). Accordingly, item 22 on the 2013 Form will not be shown as held or sold on the 2014

Form. Once agam, I will amend the 2013 Form if that is required.

(3) The audit function stated that 1 should mark items 128 and 132 in Part VII as "Closed (Part)," but this is not an option in the drop-down menu for dispositions.

The Committee staff said that | should indicate this issue here,

(4) This second amendment is to report a previously inadvertantly non-disclosed asset. On 4/19/06 Jl invested $9,500 in the Fidelity Founding mutual fund,

held m Jl IRA. On 5/16/13, thut investment was converted to the Franklin Moderate Allocation mutual fund, with a value of $11,981.09. There have never been

uny outside contributions or withdrawals from this fund, and its growth is from automatic re-investment of dividends.

I reported the 2014 Franklin Moderate Allocation income on line 103 of the disclosure form, but had inadvertently failed to report the two assets (Fidelity

Founding converted to the Franklin Moderate Allocution in 2013) and the dividends derived therefrom on my 2013 disclosure. When | recently telephoned the

staff for the Committee on Financial Disclosure, they suggested | make this disclosure here in Section VIII, rather than also amending my 2013 report.
